summary: All three semantic checks passed. The spec accurately captures GBALD's two-stage contribution (ellipsoid core-set construction + geometric BALD ranking), essential model features are correctly classified, and the single scale-dependent hyperparameter (R_0) is properly declared.

checks_summary.note: Summary names both GBALD stages (ellipsoid core-set + BALD ranking with geometric representativeness), matching the paper abstract and introduction precisely.

Three features declared: dropout active at inference (essential — correct, BALD degrades without it), dropout rate 0.5 (important — reasonable, affects calibration not correctness), standard classifier head (essential — correct, BALD needs per-class probabilities). No over-marking.

R_0 (Eq. 5 distance threshold) declared with paper_value=2000.0 and assumes_data_scale=raw_pixel_unnormalized. The eta factor (Eq. 11) is dimensionless and correctly omitted. Theoretical radii (R_a, R_b from proofs) correctly omitted as non-algorithmic.

caveats: The pluggable_component signature correctly follows the bayesian sub-paradigm override (includes x_labeled). The data_setup values form a consistent MNIST benchmark: initial_labeled=20, batch_size=100, num_rounds=6, total_budget=620 (arithmetic: 20 + 6*100 = 620). No methodology_replication_contract was present in the final spec (removed during fix-loop), so the contract baseline check did not apply.
